now.title: Cloak & Dagger#17
now.text: After the shooting splits O'Reilly in two, her violent half, Mayhem, opens fire at a trafficking site, and Tyrone absorbs her into his cloak while shielding a guard. In the Dark Dimension she repays him, swapping the records Andre uses to manipulate him and tipping him off that Tandy was taken.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Her violent half, Mayhem, gets trapped in Tyrone's cloak, then helps him in the Dark Dimension.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The teleporter who absorbs O'Reilly's violent half, then gets her help.

proposed.text: Ever since Tyrone absorbed O'Reilly's violent half, Mayhem, into his cloak during her rampage at a trafficking site, she has been trapped in the Dark Dimension. There she repays him, swapping the records Andre uses to manipulate him and spurring him to go find Tandy.

changes.evidence: Mayhem shooting up the trafficking site and Tyrone sucking her into the Darkforce while saving a kid guard happens in #13 (S2E3 'Shadow Selves'), not #17. In #17 (S2E7 'Vikingtown Sound') Mayhem, already in the Dark Dimension, replaces Andre's recording and destroys his records so Tyrone resumes his search for Tandy. Text reworded so the #13 event reads as backstory; title and card lines unchanged.

now.title: Luke Cage S1#8
now.text: Diamondback shoots Luke Cage with a Judas bullet while Luke walks with Claire, then tracks them down to the clinic where she is trying to dig it out. When he grabs her through the window, Claire stabs him in the arm.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Shoots Luke and grabs Claire. She stabs him in the arm.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Luke's companion. Stabs Diamondback in the arm when he grabs her.

proposed.text: After Diamondback shoots Luke Cage with a Judas bullet while Luke walks with Claire, he flips the ambulance carrying them, then tracks them to the clinic where she is trying to dig the bullet out. When he grabs her through the window, Claire stabs him in the arm.

changes.evidence: The Judas-bullet shooting during Luke and Claire's walk ends Luke Cage S1#7 ('Manifest'). In #8 ('Blowin' Up the Spot') Diamondback blows up the ambulance, then attacks the Harlem Women's Clinic, where Claire stabs him in the arm when he grabs her through the window. Text reworded so the #7 shooting reads as backstory; title and card lines unchanged.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#17
now.text: Gideon Malick secretly leads HYDRA, and when Phil Coulson comes to him about it, Malick warns him not to get ahead of himself. After Malick's HYDRA kills Coulson's lover Rosalind Price, Coulson hunts him down.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Director who hunts Malick down after Hydra kills Rosalind.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Secret Hydra head whose people kill Rosalind, so Coulson hunts him down.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#11
proposed.text: Gideon Malick secretly leads HYDRA, and his people kill Coulson's lover Rosalind Price. Coulson calls him and vows to bring down everything he has built, and Malick warns him not to get ahead of himself.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Director who vows to bring Malick down after Hydra kills Rosalind.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Secret Hydra head whose people kill Rosalind. Warns Coulson not to get ahead of himself.

changes.evidence: Malick has Ward kill Rosalind in S3#8 ('Many Heads, One Tale'). The 'don't get too far ahead of yourself' phone call, their first direct clash, is S3#11 ('Bouncing Back'). At #17 ('The Team') Coulson already holds Malick prisoner. So the stage should start at #11, with the capture moved to a later stage (added below).

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#17
proposed.text: Coulson's team captures Malick, and Coulson talks him into giving up HYDRA's bases. Hive then sends Daisy to kill Malick in his cell.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Director who captures Malick and turns him against Hydra.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Captured Hydra head who gives up Hydra's bases before he is killed.

changes.evidence: In S3#17 ('The Team') Lincoln captures Malick; in the Playground Coulson persuades him to betray Hydra and he hands over Hydra's base locations; Daisy, under Hive's control, then kills him. This keeps the original stage's 'Coulson hunts him down' at the right episode.

now.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
now.text: Yondu refuses to hand Groot over to his Ravagers. After Taserface takes the ship, Groot helps Yondu and Rocket escape by fetching Yondu's prototype fin.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Ravager who protects Groot, and whom Groot helps escape by fetching his fin.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Little Guardian Yondu protects, who fetches his prototype fin.

proposed.text: Yondu's Ravagers capture Groot, then mutiny when Yondu will not hand Peter Quill over. Groot keeps fetching the wrong things from Yondu's quarters until Kraglin helps him bring back the prototype fin, and Yondu and Rocket break out.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Ravager captain whom Groot, with Kraglin's help, frees by bringing his fin.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Little Guardian who, with Kraglin's help, brings Yondu his prototype fin.

changes.evidence: In Vol. 2 Yondu hesitates to turn over Quill, not Groot, which sparks Taserface's mutiny. Groot fails several times to fetch the fin (underwear, a desk, an eye, a toe), and Kraglin finally gets the controller and helps free Yondu and Rocket. The current text and both card lines say Groot fetched it himself and that Yondu refused to hand over Groot.

now.title: Runaways S1–S2#15
now.text: Topher follows Molly to the hostel, and she pleads for him to stay, hoping he might be family. Her trust breaks when she finds he lied about his strength.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The boy Molly trusts, until his lies come out.

proposed.title: Runaways S1–S2#14
proposed.text: Topher follows Molly to the hostel, and she pleads for him to stay, hoping he might be family. Then Nico finds he lied about where his strength comes from.

changes.evidence: Runaways S1 has 10 episodes, so #15 is S2E5 ('Rock Bottom'), where Topher steals the dig-site map and fights Molly before being crushed by a dumpster. He follows Molly to the hostel in S2E3 (#13). Molly hopes he is family, and Nico exposes his Gibborim-rock vial, in S2E4 (#14). The friendship and the lie belong at #14. Card lines unchanged.
